ns2:course.label: Senior Thesis
ns2:course.description: Guidance in the writing of a senior thesis involving independent research (usually performed during the summer prior to the fall semester). Additional activities include oral presentations of research and outside journal articles, proposal writing and reviewing, poster presentation, preparation of graduate school applications, and discussion of physics frontiers with outside experts. 3 undergraduate hours. Prerequisite: PHYS 496; completion of appropriate research activity.
